note: The OLG provides comprehensive coverage of work requirements as a condition of SNAP participation. FNS 850 covers three main areas: (1) E&T participation (Element 160), (2) time-limited participation/ABAWD (Element 161), and (3) work registration (Element 162). The OLG addresses all three through an extensive 'SNAP Work Rules (General and ABAWD)' section hierarchy. General work rules are covered on 'The General Work Rules' page (work registration at application/recert, accepting employment, voluntary quit/reduction of hours with $217.50/week threshold, self-employment exception). Exemptions and screening are detailed on 'The SNAP Work Rules Screening Page' with BEACON procedures and exemption examples. ABAWD/time-limited participation is covered across 'ABAWD Work Rules Overview', 'ABAWD Work Rules Exemptions', and 'ABAWD Work Rules Participation' pages. E&T is covered on the 'SNAP Path to Work Program' page describing DTA's SNAP E&T program with components matching FNS requirements (job search, training, education, work experience). Voluntary quit and disqualification procedures are thoroughly documented on 'SNAP Voluntary Quit and Reduction of Work Hours' and 'SNAP Disqualifications and Sanctions' pages, including good cause criteria on a dedicated 'Good Cause Criteria for Not Complying with the General Work Rules' page (covering noncitizens without work authorization, domestic violence, crisis situations). The OLG's coverage is worker-actionable with BEACON procedures throughout. The L1 assessment that the OLG 'focuses on exemptions and special cases rather than stating the baseline work requirement' was incorrect — the baseline requirement is clearly stated on both the 'Introduction to the SNAP Work Rules' and 'The General Work Rules' pages.
